candidates.name: Apollo.io
candidates.verdict: PICK: data + sequences + MCP; use for list building, enrichment, low-volume sequences, LinkedIn tasks

candidates.name: Instantly
candidates.verdict: Add when sending >~1,000 cold emails/week across several inboxes

candidates.name: lemlist
candidates.verdict: Multichannel incl. LinkedIn automation USD 87/mo; LinkedIn ToS risk

decision: Use Apollo for finding and enriching ICP lists, email verification, and sequences at modest volume. Its MCP connector means Claude can run research-to-draft loops. If cold email becomes the main channel, keep Apollo for data and move sending to Instantly with multiple warmed inboxes on a separate domain.
details: Check your Apollo plan tier; free-plan sequence and send limits were not shown on the public page.

verify.note: Apollo's official MCP (https://mcp.apollo.io/mcp, OAuth) confirmed: search, enrich, sequences, tasks, analytics. Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http apollo https://mcp.apollo.io/mcp. Caveat: free accounts registered with a personal email can't use search/enrich/contact matching via MCP. Free plan connects Gmail only (confirmed).
